name: nerdynik-obsidian-ps-toolkit
description: Skills for working inside Obsidian vaults on Professional Services, C&SI, and SI engagements: the customer/partner/practice/company folder taxonomy, tracking people across accounts and projects, org charts maintained as both a Mermaid diagram and a DrawIO file, and daily summaries built from call recordings and calendar data. Depends on nerdynik-obsidian-toolkit for Project Manager plan data and nerdynik-diagram-toolkit for the Mermaid and draw.io toolchains; pairs with nerdynik-plaud-toolkit when recordings come from Plaud.
